digest.component_or_area: CLI help system and command discovery
propositions: Pure-intercept routes lack visibility in overview help and fail under 'rebar help <command>' due to help predicates not excluding hidden and retired routes
Parser factories for reconcile.build, enrich.build, identity.build, and certs.build_trusted_env lack descriptions needed for overview help population
The identity child parsers (create, use, key) disable help actions causing them to reach top-level usage and error instead of returning child usage
CLI reference generation uses independent rendering instead of consuming committed help artifacts, causing maintenance divergence
Stale comments throughout the codebase incorrectly claim intercept routes lack committed help, creating developer documentation inaccuracy
